name: zopt_render_section_set_target_window
description: zOpt::RenderSection_SetTargetWindow stores the render-section window node and applies the active render rectangle to the target window.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this view-rectangle helper; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zOpt/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x408570 validates storing the target at render-section offset 0x24, doing nothing further for a null target, and applying width/height through gwWindowSetResolution plus x/y through gwWindowSetSize for a non-null target.
The native smoke verifies target storage and propagated window resolution/viewport dimensions.
